cohort: Pregnant women who delivered between 2008-2014 in the US, including women aged 38-43 years with IVF conceptions and women with spontaneous conceptions, as well as a comparison group of IVF pregnancies in women < 38 years of age.
finding: IVF pregnancies in women of advanced maternal age (AMA) are associated with a higher risk of adverse obstetrical outcomes compared to spontaneous AMA pregnancies, while neonatal outcomes remain comparable.
